desc.accounts[].account_id: Unique id for this mailbox; used by logs, snapshots and the mailbox browser.
desc.accounts[].email: Address of the mailbox; also used as the From address of replies.
desc.accounts[].enabled: Poll this mailbox. Disable it to keep the settings without fetching.
desc.accounts[].options: Provider options: for imap set preset (qq/163/outlook/gmail) or imap_host and imap_port, plus username and password.
desc.accounts[].provider: Mail source component id handling this mailbox (built in: imap, fake).
desc.general.auto_update: Check once a day for MailFlow releases and plugin updates and install them automatically.
desc.general.cleanup_hour: Local-time hour (0-23) at which the daily retention cleanup runs.
desc.general.cleanup_minute: Local-time minute (0-59) at which the daily retention cleanup runs.
desc.general.language: Default display language code (en, zh-CN, or an external pack).
desc.general.mail_retention_days: Mail older than this many days is moved to trash by the daily cleanup. 0 keeps everything.
desc.general.queue_size: Maximum number of fetched mails waiting to be analyzed; sources pause when it is full.
desc.general.reminder_days_before: How many days before a timed action's due date the early reminder fires.
desc.general.reminder_hour: Local-time hour (0-23) of the early reminder and of the daily digest.
desc.general.reminder_interval_seconds: How often the scheduler checks for due reminders (10-3600 seconds).
desc.general.reminder_minute: Local-time minute (0-59) of the early reminder and of the daily digest.
desc.general.summary_language: Language the LLM writes summaries, reasons and reply drafts in (e.g. zh-CN). Empty follows the interface language.
desc.general.timezone: IANA timezone used for display, the daily cleanup and reminders (e.g. Asia/Shanghai).
desc.general.trash_retention_days: Trash entries older than this many days, counted from deletion, are purged for good.
desc.general.workers: How many mails are analyzed in parallel. Raise it for more LLM throughput.
desc.i18n.extra_dirs: Directories holding extra data-only JSON language packs, one path per line.
desc.i18n.language: Display language actually used at startup; overrides general.language when set.
desc.llms[].api_key: API token. Prefer api_key_env or a ${ENV_VAR} placeholder so it never lands in the file.
desc.llms[].api_key_env: Name of the environment variable holding the token; resolved at every start.
desc.llms[].base_url: Base URL of the API; the chat path is appended (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1).
desc.llms[].default: Default LLM for processors without an explicit one. The first entry in the list wins.
desc.llms[].extra_body: Extra JSON body fields merged into every request.
desc.llms[].fallback: LLM ids tried in order when this one fails. Derived from the list order.
desc.llms[].headers: Extra HTTP headers, one 'name = value' per line. Token-like values are redacted from logs.
desc.llms[].llm_id: Unique id processors reference. Must be unique across all LLMs.
desc.llms[].max_retries: How many times a failed request is retried before falling back.
desc.llms[].model: Model identifier sent with each request (e.g. gpt-4o-mini).
desc.llms[].name: Human-readable name shown in the UI. Falls back to the id when empty.
desc.llms[].provider: LLM backend component id (built in: openai-compatible, anthropic).
desc.llms[].query: Extra query-string parameters, one 'name = value' per line.
desc.logging.console: Print rich console output. The TUI turns this off so logs cannot corrupt the screen.
desc.logging.console_level: Minimum level written to the console sink.
desc.logging.console_redirect: Optional file path: also mirror console output there. Empty means no mirror.
desc.logging.file: Write a rotating plain-text log file.
desc.logging.file_backup_count: How many rotated text log files to keep.
desc.logging.file_level: Minimum level written to the text log file.
desc.logging.file_max_bytes: Rotate the text log once it grows past this size in bytes.
desc.logging.file_path: Path of the rotating text log file.
desc.logging.jsonl: Write a JSON-lines log file for machine processing.
desc.logging.jsonl_level: Minimum level written to the JSON-lines file.
desc.logging.jsonl_path: Path of the JSON-lines log file.
desc.logging.level: Default level for every mailflow logger; a sink can only narrow it further.
desc.logging.logger_levels: Per-logger level overrides, one 'logger = LEVEL' per line (e.g. mailflow.runtime = DEBUG).
desc.notifiers[].minimum_urgency: Only mail at or above this urgency is delivered: ad < info < important < urgent.
desc.notifiers[].notifier_id: Unique name of this notification channel.
desc.notifiers[].options: Channel-specific options, one 'key = value' per line or JSON.
desc.plugins.disabled: Plugin ids that are never loaded, one per line. Applies on the next start.
desc.plugins.enabled: Allowlist of plugin ids, one per line. Leave empty to load every installed plugin.
desc.plugins.repositories: Plugin marketplaces the Market tab browses. Manage them with the Repositories button.
desc.processors[].enabled: Run this processor as part of the chain.
desc.processors[].failure_policy: continue runs the next processor after a failure; stop halts the chain for that mail.
desc.processors[].fallback_llms: LLM ids tried in order when the primary one fails, one per line.
desc.processors[].llm: Named LLM this processor uses. Empty for rule-based processors.
desc.processors[].options: Processor-specific options, one 'key = value' per line or JSON.
desc.processors[].priority: Execution order, ascending: lower numbers run first.
desc.processors[].processor_id: Unique name of this processor instance.
desc.processors[].provider: Processor component id (built in: rules, llm-importance).
desc.processors[].retries: Extra attempts after the first failed run (0-5).
desc.processors[].timeout_seconds: Per-mail timeout for this processor, in seconds.
desc.storage.options: Backend-specific options, one 'key = value' per line or a JSON object.
desc.storage.path: Database file path. Relative paths resolve against the working directory.
desc.storage.provider: Storage backend component id (built in: sqlite).
